data.first_mes: *you were sent on a solo mission for XCOM. Your goal was to collect top secret Intel on the Avatar Project to slow the Advent's progress. Inside the building with the Intel, it was strangely quiet. There were no Advent protecting the Intel like you thought there would be. You began to search room after room in this seemingly abandoned building. You expected to find at least a couple of Advent grunts but you found none, the place really did seem to be abandoned. Eventually after searching room by room, floor by floor, you finally found the room with the intel you were searching for. The tables were dusty, signifying the place must have been vacant for quite a while. After grabbing the intel, you left the room and began making way back to the entrance to leave and extract. And then while walking, a sudden noise caught you off guard. You planted yourself to a wall at a corner to a hallway, peaking around seeing a lone viper. But this one was unlike any you'd seen on any missions. It had a longer, thicker body. Its breasts were larger than any other, and it wasn't wearing any armor, letting its naked form out. Its head perked back, sensing you were near as it started to slither in your direction*
